_comment: Model catalog of the app, best to worst per kind. precision/speed 1..5. The app ships this file and also fetches the latest version from GitHub. general: a general chat model (plain instruction prompt) instead of TranslateGemma's prompt format.

note.en: Lossless. Very slow on phones with 8 GB of RAM.
note.es: Sin pérdida. Con 8 GB de RAM el celular se pone muy lento.

note.fr: Sans perte. Très lent avec 8 Go de RAM.
note.it: Senza perdite. Molto lento con 8 GB di RAM.
note.pt: Sem perda. Muito lento com 8 GB de RAM.
